name: Sturm-TP
author: sd88me
summary: Six-voice analog-style drum and synth voice modelled on a classic drum machine: two analog and two sample oscillators, 2/4-pole lowpass, highpass, five envelopes, two LFOs, eight mod paths, kit mode, distortion, compressor and a delay that plays repeated notes, with a bank browser and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links. Loads its sound and project SysEx dumps.
